metadata.host_identification_method: experimental transparent heuristic; no trained classifier
metadata.host_score_warning: Scores and confidence bands are heuristic, not calibrated probabilities. Opening/closing phrase lists are incomplete and currently English-oriented; translated ASR text can affect cues. Manually verify predictions and evaluate across known-host episodes.

methodology.transition_definition: A structural change from one diarized speaker turn to the next; not proof of interruption or floor allocation.
methodology.overlap_definition: OSD aggregate overlap pair statistics are preserved separately from speaker transitions.
methodology.interruption_definition: Only existing merge_final.json osd_stats.interruptions_by_pair labels are counted as interruptions; no new interruption labels are inferred.
methodology.response_definition: A subsequent turn by the previous speaker within 3 seconds is temporal re-entry only, not a semantically verified response.
methodology.subtopic_assignment: Each timestamped transition is assigned once to the subtopic containing its timestamp (start inclusive, end exclusive). Aggregate overlap/interruption records have no event timestamps and are not allocated to subtopics.
methodology.floor_allocation_policy: Transitions involving the host are not automatically interpreted as deliberate floor allocation.

episode_summary.note: Pairwise overlap seconds may be summed across pairs; this is not unique wall-clock overlap duration.

interruption_analysis.limitation: Source provides aggregate pair counts/durations without timestamps; event-level and subtopic-level interruption analysis is unavailable.

overlap_analysis.limitation: Pair-level aggregate only; no event timestamps in merge_final.json after this variant preprocessing.

host_interaction.floor_allocation_status: not_inferred_from_transitions; no timestamped verified floor-allocation labels supplied

response_patterns.limitation: Temporal re-entry only; does not establish that the speaker answered or responded semantically.
